Fonts embedded in the Skywave Link GUI
======================================

These TTF files are the copies distributed with Dear ImGui (misc/fonts).
CMake compiles them into the skywave_link binary (see CMakeLists.txt,
"UI fonts"); they are not loaded from disk at run time. The license of
each font is the one recorded in the font file's own metadata (name table).

Roboto-Medium.ttf
  Copyright 2011 Google Inc. All Rights Reserved.
  Licensed under the Apache License, Version 2.0
  https://www.apache.org/licenses/LICENSE-2.0

Cousine-Regular.ttf
  Digitized data copyright (c) 2010 Google Corporation.
  Licensed under the SIL Open Font License, Version 1.1
  https://openfontlicense.org (formerly http://scripts.sil.org/OFL)
  The OFL permits bundling and embedding the font with software,
  including commercial software, provided the font is not sold by itself.
  (Older Cousine releases, and Dear ImGui's FONTS.md, list Apache 2.0;
  the metadata of this file states OFL 1.1.)
